title: Reconstruct the particle from detector data
promptMarkdown: In one inertial frame a particle has energy $13\varepsilon$ and momentum $(3,4,0)\varepsilon/c$, where $\varepsilon>0$ is an energy unit. Find its invariant mass, velocity vector and Lorentz factor. Specify the boost into its rest frame and the energy measured there. Explain why the number 13 alone cannot determine its mass.
hintLadder: Square the spatial momentum as a Euclidean vector.
Use $\mathbf v=c^2\mathbf p/E$, then verify the inferred gamma.
Boost along the momentum direction, not only along the x axis.
